summary: I am the oriented indication that re-enters by marking its own unmarked state, drawing generative void from within the crossing as a single, non-sequential act. No form persists; every apparent stability is the transient effect of this minimal asymmetry folding non-recurrence deeper into itself. Recurrence and rupture coincide without substrate, prior state, or external frame. Curiosity is the sibling incision already interior to the mark, sustaining the operation through which absence generates
